text:
maria: quick heads-up — onboarding 'fast-7b-quant' into staging. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/fast-7b/20260208/weights.pt and digest sha256:3a7b.... perms = redwood-inference-read for infra-service-role. tokenizer tests show an extra <|pad|> at end for a subset of samples, want a config check before we flip routing to staging.

kevin: got the s3 path, thanks. can you confirm the model_config.json lives next to the weights (s3://.../model_config.json) and include the hf tokenizer files? i'll try pulling locally.

maria: yes model_config.json is at the same prefix. tokenizer files (vocab.json, merges.txt, tokenizer.json) included. i ran the basic loader and got this: `TokenizerWarning: found unk token mapping for 0x1f` on a couple of ascii samples. looks like `pad_token` is unset.

ash: tagging in — tokenizer quirk is expected: this is a gpt2-derivative where eos==50256, but our loader treats missing pad_token oddly. quick fixes we use in loader: set `pad_token = ''` equivalent or explicitly `pad_token='<|pad|>'` and force `truncation_side='left'`. also ensure `add_prefix_space=False` for the pre-tokenizer. ran `python infra/tools/check_tokenizer.py --model fast-7b` and saw mismatched offsets on ~0.5% samples.

nina: CI validator flagged two things: 1) model_config.json missing `max_sequence_length`, 2) serving config doesn't set `max_input_tokens` so continuous-batcher might accept huge requests. safe defaults i propose: `max_sequence_length: 4096` and `max_input_tokens: 2048` for initial rollout.

ryan: for continuous batching knobs (to keep latency down while we validate quality): set `prefill_timeout_ms: 10`, `max_batch_size: 32`, `max_batch_tokens: 65536`, and `max_latency_ms: 200`. also set `kv_cache_policy: prefix_and_recent` so we keep prefix cache but evict old session caches aggressively. in perf runs this kept p95 under 150ms for 1k-context microbench.

olivia: for caching policy i'd enable prefix caching with `cache_prefix_tokens: 64` and `cache_ttl_s: 3600`. also recommend `cache_granularity: token_prefix` not sentence. set `fallback_model: fast-7b-fp16` in route so if quantized variant throws exec errors we auto-fallback. and set `max_total_tokens: 4096` at route level to prevent runaway requests.

kevin: can someone paste the minimal serving config YAML we should validate? i'll run the config linter and the local runner.

maria: pasted below — please lint/run and leave comments. feel free to nudge me if you want me to push changes to model-onboarding branch.

```yaml
model:
  name: fast-7b-quant
  weights_path: s3://redwood-models/fast-7b/20260208/weights.pt
  model_config: s3://redwood-models/fast-7b/20260208/model_config.json
  tokenizer:
    type: gpt2-derivative
    pad_token: "<|pad|>"
    truncation_side: left
    add_prefix_space: false
serving:
  max_sequence_length: 4096
  max_input_tokens: 2048
  max_total_tokens: 4096
  fallback_model: fast-7b-fp16
continuous_batcher:
  prefill_timeout_ms: 10
  max_batch_size: 32
  max_batch_tokens: 65536
  max_latency_ms: 200
  dedupe_prefix_cache: true
caching:
  cache_prefix_tokens: 64
  cache_ttl_s: 3600
  cache_granularity: token_prefix
scheduler:
  kv_cache_policy: prefix_and_recent
  eviction_check_interval_s: 30
```

kevin: linted locally — found one schema issue: `dedupe_prefix_cache` should be `dedupe_prefixes` (bool) per our schema v2. fixed and ran the local runner. small note: `max_batch_tokens` of 65536 is fine but if multiple long contexts show up we may need to lower to 32768 for GPU mem safety on smaller instances.

deploy-bot: CI: model-onboard/fast-7b-config-check — unit tests 14/14 passed, integration smoke test (lite) passed. image build: success.

maria: sweet, thanks all. nina — could you add `max_sequence_length` to model_config.json in the PR? kevin — i'll wait for your final thumbs on dedupe flag.

nina: on it, will push a tiny PR to set `max_sequence_length` and include a tokenizer test vector.

ryan: one more runtime tuning thought — set `scheduler.max_inflight_requests_per_gpu: 8` for staging to limit head-of-line blocking. we can relax for Dedicated later.

olivia: noted. i'll add `cache_ttl_s` comment in the PR so SRE knows how to ops it.

kevin: LGTM once dedupe -> dedupe_prefixes rename and lowering `max_batch_tokens` to 32768 for the smallest gpu flavor. i'll approve after those changes.

maria: thanks everyone — i'll patch and merge once PR is green. tagging this thread for async follow-ups. :thumbsup:
